title.narrative: In 2024, Bangladesh made significant strides in child justice, advancing the implementation of the Children Act, 2013. This included training over 3,000 social workers and 500 judicial and law enforcement officials on child-sensitive legal processes, resulting in a 30% increase in the use of diversion and alternative measures to detention for children in conflict with the law. Through strengthened multisectoral coordination, more than 20,000 children accessed child-friendly legal aid and support services, promoting restorative justice and ensuring a more inclusive and protective justice system for children.
